641:t_016:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though at the time, I was traveling alone as I pleased.」

641:t_016:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Why did you oppose $$ジェミニス$$... $$サイデリアル$$?」

641:t_016:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We stand above $$サイデリアル$$. We must guide them, including the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s, toward strength.」

641:t_016:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So I deliberately became an obstacle. And the same was true for you.」

641:t_016:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why I guided you toward the truth, sometimes as an ally, sometimes as an enemy.」

641:t_016:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「As a result, you defeated the $$新地球皇国$$ and were able to face the $$御使い$$s like this.」

641:t_016:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you dissatisfied, $$ドクトリン$$?」

641:t_016:22.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「No... I, too, have left the past behind.」

641:t_016:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's the spirit. I commend your efforts during my absence.」

641:t_016:24.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you treated $n as your possession, too, and twisted his fate however you liked!?」

641:t_016:25.en:
$$赤木$$
「You were pulling strings to make him grow as a $$スフィア・リアクター$$!?」

641:t_016:26.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am no god, so I cannot do that much. His contact with the $$いがみ合う双子$$ resulted from several coincidences.」

641:t_016:27.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And my interest in him arose because of his mother.」

641:t_016:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「So $n's mother... Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$...」

641:t_016:30.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「She was an outstanding human.」

641:t_016:31.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「By combining super-dimensional physics with archaeology, she sought to discover the $$御使い$$s independently through prehistoric ruins.」

641:t_016:32.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So I punished her.」

641:t_016:34.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I plunged her into despair and drove her to take her beloved son's life.」

641:t_016:35.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What happened next was surprising. Through her willpower, she transcended despair and hope, and protected her son by taking her own life.」

641:t_016:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's the truth behind your mother's death, $n...」

641:t_016:37.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「After that, I became interested in her son... in other words, $F.」

641:t_016:38.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I thought that if I gave him despair, he might acquire the power to transcend hope and despair, as his mother had...」

641:t_016:39.en:
$$シン$$
「That's why you... $n's father and sister!!」

641:t_016:41.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And then he encountered the $$いがみ合う双子$$. That is what makes the world so interesting.」

641:t_016:42.en:
$$桂$$
「He has been toying with $n's fate all along...」

641:t_016:43.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You scum! What gives you the right!?」

641:t_016:44.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's nothing unusual. Across the universe, roughly 93,274 children like him have been subjects of my experiments.」

641:t_016:45.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n, the fruit of those experiments... You are worthy of receiving my love.」

641:t_016:46.en:
$n
「...You've told me something good, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

641:t_016:48.en:
$$葵$$
「Don't tell me you're going to submit to his power...!」

641:t_016:49.en:
$n
「Mom really was my mom after all... I don't have to hate her or be afraid of her anymore...」

641:t_016:51.en:
$n
「I'll never forgive you! You took Dad's life, Sis's... and Mom's, too!!」

641:t_016:52.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So he has shaken off the proof in his blood by his own will.」

641:t_016:53.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「See? Isn't that boy fun?」

641:t_016:54.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But that isn't true of $n alone.」

641:t_016:55.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$c... and indeed everyone living on that Earth, is seeking to reach the sun's radiance.」

641:t_016:56.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So we must pass judgment after all.」

641:t_016:57.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Shut the hell up, you villains!」

641:t_016:58.en:
$$万丈$$
「I suspect this 'judgment' is just an enforced execution, without a defender or any hearing for our side.」

641:t_016:59.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then we'll resist with all our strength! To protect our future!」

641:t_016:60.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Idiots are so much fun!」

641:t_016:61.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Perfect. Preparations are complete in the $$メイオール$$ Galaxy of the 23rd World.」

641:t_016:62.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We can manage that one even in our current state.」

641:t_016:63.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

641:t_016:64.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We are $$御使い$$s... those who wield the Supreme God's power.」

641:t_016:65.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We oversee the fate of all living beings in all worlds and pass judgment when necessary.」

641:t_016:66.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I'll send the images straight into your brains.」

641:t_016:67.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The moment an entire galaxy vanishes.」

641:t_017:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's a bluff! It has to be an illusion to scare us!」

641:t_017:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've confirmed it through super-dimensional observation...! That footage... shows something that really happened!」

641:t_017:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「An entire galaxy... wiped out so easily...」

641:t_017:8.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't like this. Just three of them do something like that as casually as pulling weeds...!」

641:t_017:9.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do not misunderstand, $$始原の特異点$$. I carry this out as my duty, with great anger.」

641:t_017:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$テンプティ$$ does it because it's fun, though.」

641:t_017:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The act itself is indeed destruction, but it is necessary to save the universe as a whole.」

641:t_017:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I feel joy at having carried it out.」

641:t_017:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「There is no need for words anymore! You're devils who toy with others' lives and fates!」

641:t_017:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「'Devil' is a word that belongs to $$バアル$$.」

641:t_017:16.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「One who opposes them and protects the universe's future... That is the one worthy of calling itself God.」

641:t_017:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「The $$御使い$$s are that God's emissaries.」

641:t_017:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, steel yourselves! We cannot leave them unchecked!」

641:t_017:19.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「They are enemies of all living beings...!」

641:t_017:20.en:
$$號$$
「They are the fundamental calamity... the worst enemy waiting beyond evolution!」

641:t_017:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That fighting spirit... Even if it comes from ignorance, it is impressive.」

641:t_017:22.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But $$テンプティ$$ and the others aren't the ones who'll fight you.」

641:t_017:23.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We came here to awaken the system sleeping at the pole.」
